of.needed: whether the Kafka cluster has custom logging configuration (the evidence does not name the CR field or ConfigMap that carries it)

consequence.statement: Kafka 4.0 and newer logs via Log4j2 instead of Reload4j/Log4j1, so an environment upgrading to Kafka 4.0 with custom logging configuration might need to update that configuration during the upgrade (the evidence only says it "might" be needed, not that something fails).
consequence.remediation: Review custom logging configuration and update it for Log4j2 when upgrading to Kafka 4.0, as the changelog advises.

assertion.statement: Kafka 4.0 and newer uses Log4j2 for logging instead of Reload4j/Log4j1, so environments with custom logging configuration might need to update it during the upgrade to Kafka 4.0.
